heading: INT. FIELD HOSPITAL - CONVERTED SKI LODGE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. FIELD HOSPITAL - CONVERTED SKI LODGE - NIGHT
A great timber hall with a stone hearth, now lined with cots.
Antlers still hang over the mantel.
Blizzard wind works the shutters.
DR. SAOIRSE KELLEHER, 40, mud on her boots and blood on her cuffs, stands over a cot with a stethoscope draped around her neck.
She has not slept in two days and she holds her face carefully, like something fragile on a tray.
NURSE ABIODUN, 30, sets out instruments on a ski-rack trolley.
He works precisely, wasting no motion.
On the cot, MRS. HELENA PAVLICEK, 70, lies pale under three blankets, her breath shallow.
At the foot of the bed, her husband GREGOR PAVLICEK, 72, holds his hat in both hands, turning it by the brim.
Mr. Pavlicek. The avalanche took her ribs, and one of them has nicked the lung.
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: She was talking on the way down.
units.name: GREGOR

units.text: I know.
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: She checks the pulse at Helena's wrist.
She counts, and he waits, and she finds nothing to say about the number.
You'll operate.
units.name: GREGOR

units.text: We would have to open the chest. I have a surgical kit and a lantern. The helicopter can't land for another night.
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: Then do it.
units.name: GREGOR

units.text: Doctor, the generator's down to an hour.
units.name: ABIODUN

units.text: She glances at him.
He looks back, steady.
In that look is a whole second conversation.
Then we have an hour.
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: I said do it.
units.name: GREGOR

units.text: I heard you.
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: She turns, takes a scalpel from the trolley, and holds it up to the light.
Her hand is perfectly steady.
Gregor takes a step forward.
He sets his hat on the bed.
His knuckles are white.
And if you cut and she dies on your table?
units.name: GREGOR

units.text: Then she dies knowing someone tried.
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: Then I forbid it.
units.name: GREGOR

units.text: Sir.
units.name: ABIODUN

units.text: She is mine. Fifty years. I will not have her opened by a stranger in a dead man's hunting lodge.
units.name: GREGOR

units.text: He grabs Saoirse's wrist.
The scalpel stops in the air.
Abiodun moves in, but she shakes her head, and he freezes.
Mr. Pavlicek. Look at her.
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: He does not want to.
He does.
Helena's eyes are open, and they have found him.
Her lips move.
Greg. Let go.
units.name: HELENA

units.text: His grip loosens.
The scalpel lowers.
The wind slams the shutters, and somewhere the generator stutters.
